subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The e2e-review lens set shall include lenses for coverage completeness, anti-gaming (a scenario reds if the behavior breaks; no mock hollows out what it proves), and buildability (the harness section answers every element it owes, and every scenario is buildable against the harness as specified).
rationale: each mandated lens maps to a real e2e risk and carries a proving eval (§5.9); buildability is the lens that would have caught a harness section carrying no mechanics; the set is named here, its wording refined in design
fit_criterion: the catch corpus (seeded coverage gaps, hollow scenarios, and harness holes) is flagged by the coverage, anti-gaming, and buildability lenses respectively (M2, M3, M4); a fully-covered fixture doc with honest mocks and a complete harness section yields no coverage, anti-gaming, or buildability finding
